description: This file defines the internal method class for loading plugins in the Smarty templating system, including logic for identifying plugin files, caching, and loading them from various directories.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_LoadPlugin
classes.description: Internal class providing the method to load Smarty plugins dynamically, with caching and directory searching features.

methods.name: loadPlugin
methods.description: Loads a plugin file based on the plugin name, checking cache and directories, throwing exceptions on invalid plugin names.
